content.title: BofA raises gold price forecasts for 2025, 2026
content.summary: BofA now expects gold to trade at $3,063 per ounce (oz) in 2025 and $3,350/oz in 2026, it said in a note on Wednesday.  This is an increase from its previous forecasts of $2,750/oz for 2025 and $2,625/oz for 2026.  Spot gold is currently trading around $3,024/oz and has gained more than 15% so far this year.
